title: Sakamoto Days
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Taro Sakamoto, once a legendary hitman, retired to run a convenience store with his wife Aoi and daughter Hana. When former colleagues and bounty hunters come for him, he and a crew of ex-criminal employees fight to protect his family while keeping Aoi's rule against killing.
life_message: Holds up a peaceful family life as worth more than power or wealth, and the idea that people can leave a violent past behind.

content.note: Frequent stylized combat with guns and blades; Common Sense Media (anime, 16+) notes gruesome deaths; AniList Gore 63%; the hero himself avoids killing.
Constant threats to the family; tense action.
